text_block_list.text: ...That's it? I got a fan letter!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: This is proof I've gotten even stronger!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
When I was young, my papa always used
to say...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A wrestler is only as strong as the
number of fans
they have!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not a wrestler, but now I know
exactly what he
meant!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
When I read fan letters, it sets my spirit
on fire!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All the voices cheering me on fuel the
flames in
my burning soul!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's the true strength my papa told me
about!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
From here on out, my fans and I will
continue
gettin' stronger and stronger!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It seems like the fan letter has stoked
her passion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
